secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (https://<project>.supabase.co) — needed for auth and database features. Get it from your Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public API key — needed for auth and database features. Get it from your Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role key (secret) — used server-side for planning-application ingest and search. Get it from your Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API > service_role.

secrets.name: PI_SYNC_KEY
secrets.description: Shared bearer secret between sync_to_pi.rb (scraper machine, PI_SYNC_KEY env var) and the /api/ingest/planning-apps endpoint. Any strong random string.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key (sk_...) — needed for checkout and subscription features. Get it from your Stripe dashboard > Developers > API keys.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe publishable key (pk_...) — needed for client-side Stripe integration. Get it from your Stripe dashboard > Developers > API keys.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...) — needed for webhook signature verification. Get it from your Stripe dashboard > Developers > Webhooks.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN
secrets.description: Mapbox public access token — needed for map features in the workspace. Get it from your Mapbox account > Access tokens.
